body.title: New tools, part 2
body.summary: Add git_symbolic_ref (get, set, delete), git_show_ref (with exists), git_merge_base (with bases), git_hash_object, git_path_history and git_fetch_refs with typebox schemas. git_symbolic_ref set and delete and git_fetch_refs carry their approval classes per the LLD; the others are none.
acceptanceChecks: Each tool returns the documented shape against a real temporary repository
git_symbolic_ref set and delete change HEAD or the named ref and ask according to their class
git_merge_base returns bases, and git_show_ref exists reports presence without failing the call
git_fetch_refs fetches the named refs only and maps unreachable and missing-signin failures

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-path-history.test.ts: git_path_history answers the introducing-commit and first-parent queries the callers run today
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-tools-integration.test.ts: git_merge_base answers all, unrelated and isAncestor cases with data that fits its schema

src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-tools-integration.test.ts: git_fetch_refs applies the policy-refresh and maintenance fetches and is destructive for a forced refspec that targets a local branch
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-tools-integration.test.ts: git_symbolic_ref sets, reads and deletes refs/remotes/origin/HEAD with the classes none, common and destructive
